faces.name: Sarek, Federation Ambassador
faces.oracleText: Federation — At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw a card for every five creature types among non-Borg creatures you control. If you draw three or more cards this way, put two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.

faces.name: Sarevok, Deadly Usurper
faces.oracleText:
When this creature specializes, seek a creature card and put it into your graveyard, then conjure two duplicates of it into your graveyard.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

faces.name: Sarevok, Deathbringer
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of each player's end step, if no permanents left the battlefield this turn, that player loses X life, where X is Sarevok's power.
Choose a Background (You can have a Background as a second commander.)

faces.name: Sarevok's Tome
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, you take the initiative.
{T}: Add {C}. If you have the initiative, add {C}{C} instead.
